profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer in Test, at Ancestry
profile.summary:
Accomplished Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with 10+ years of experience architecting and implementing robust automation and performance testing frameworks. Proven success in delivering high-quality software by leading testing strategy, streamlining CI/CD pipelines, and driving business value in agile environments. 

Expert in validating complex business services across the full stack, from API and data layers to front-end UI. Adept at mentoring QA teams, championing engineering best practices, and collaborating across diverse domains to enhance code quality, system scalability, and deployment velocity. 

Career Highlights

Designed and delivered an internal Java-based decision-support engine that synthesized behavioral and system signals to enable real-time, shift-left risk detection and faster decision-making for customer service agents. 

Accelerated agent decision cycles and improved sales effectiveness by translating complex system states into actionable guidance, reducing reliance on manual investigation and tribal knowledge. 

Drove a 20% revenue growth and improved Google organic search visibility by 27% at Overstock.com by executing end-to-end testing for a mission-critical CMS project. 

Enabled a 30% increase in deployment frequency by embedding automation and quality gates directly into CI/CD pipelines across teams. 

Improved system scalability by 25% and achieved a site-wide throughput of 90 orders/sec by developing a high-traffic performance testing framework using JMeter. 

Reduced manual testing efforts by 40% at two separate companies (Ancestry and Overstock) by designing and implementing comprehensive UI and SEO automation frameworks. 

Enhanced test execution efficiency by 20% by leading and mentoring a team of 3 QA engineers and fostering best practices for API and UI testing.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer in Test, at Ancestry
positions.description:
Architected and owned the end-to-end testing strategy for API, UI, and performance validation across key business services, including Salesforce Service Cloud. 

Acted as a technical quality leader, driving a shift-left testing strategy by influencing design decisions early in the SDLC to prevent systemic defects rather than detecting them late. 

Led Agile ceremonies as Scrum Master, facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to ensure seamless execution and team alignment. 

Championed engineering excellence by spearheading code reviews and mentoring junior engineers to foster best practices and improve overall code quality. 

 

Key Achievements: 

Accelerated agent decision cycles and contributed to increased sales conversion by translating complex system states into actionable guidance. 

Designed and scaled an API quality framework with 200+ integration tests, achieving 98% coverage and enabling early detection of service-level risks across releases. 

Built a UI and regression automation platform covering critical user flows, increasing coverage to 95%, and reducing manual validation effort by 40%. 

Architected a performance and scalability validation framework using JMeter, validating 90 orders/sec throughput and improving system scalability by 25%. 

Led cross-team code reviews focused on testability, resiliency, and long-term maintainability, contributing to 95% code coverage and higher engineering standards.

positions.title: QA/Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Executed comprehensive testing strategies for mission-critical e-commerce systems, including the Content Management System (CMS) and Order Processed Experience Question (OPEQ). 

Designed and implemented robust test automation frameworks for front-end, regression, and SEO testing to ensure product quality and performance. 

Owned the validation of data integrity for new features, verifying complex SQL scripts to ensure accuracy during deployment cycles. 

Key Achievements: 

Led end-to-end quality ownership for a CMS platform, improving organic search visibility by 27% and contributing to 20% revenue growth. 

Ensured reliability and data integrity of a customer feedback platform, driving a 20% increase in user-generated content through improved system stability. 

Built a scalable front-end automation framework that increased regression coverage by 65% and reduced manual testing by 40%. 

Owned data quality validation for deployments by reviewing and validating 100+ DDL/DML scripts, ensuring zero data integrity regressions.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Quality · Java · JMeter · JIRA

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Successfully implemented the QA processes at Sentry Insurance, AON Hewitt and US Foods
Established Test documentation like test plan, test cases and set up test data in test management tools like Quality Center and Test Manager
Created test automation scripts in Selenium IDE and webdriver, Coded UI Visual Studio 2012 for Regression Testing and QTP
Coordinated functional, end-to-end, and load testing strategies, for complex initiatives spanning multiple tech teams
Sole tester for API testing that resulted in improved website performance for risk management systems
Designed and created detailed traceability matrix in Visual Studio 2010 to identify requirements’ coverage with test cases
Trained and onboard QA team members and standardized QA testing processes
Led an offshore team which focused on Master Data Management (MDM)
Verified XML file batch jobs are loaded successfully the database
Performed extensive back-end testing/data validation by developing and executing SQL scripts using oracle 11.0
Skilled in testing within Agile, Waterfall and Spiral development environments
Proficient in using Jira, BugZilla and Clear Quest for task and bug tracking.

positions.title: System Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Implemented Six Sigma methodology to reduce the defect rate of the product which resulted in savings of $70,000 per year
Upgraded paper form work instructions into electronic work instructions on the manufacturing assembly line
